briefTitle: Immunotherapy After Surgery for People Who Have No Remaining Cancer Cells After Standard Treatment for Early-Stage Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, INSIGHT Trial

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants must have received at least two cycles of neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy and anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have had a complete (R0) resection of NSCLC (with appropriate lymph node sampling as defined by the National Comprehensive Cancer Network [NCCN] guidelines) within 84 days (12 weeks) prior to randomization. Acceptable types of surgical resection are: lobectomy, sleeve resection, bi-lobectomy, or pneumonectomy. Wedge resection is not allowed.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical resection details and complete R0 status are procedural criteria, not typed biomarker or organ checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have a pathologic complete response (pCR) (no viable tumor in the resected specimen or lymph nodes), as determined by local pathology review
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pathologic response evaluation is a specialized clinical assessment outside standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have a PD-L1 status result (e.g. [< 1% versus >= 1% or unknown])
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requiring a status result to be known/reported is not a simple pdl1_min or pdl1_max cutoff check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have received any prior systemic therapy (systemic chemotherapy, immunotherapy or investigational drug) within 28 days prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior systemic therapy washout window involves multiple categories of therapies and is not mapped to a single typed prior therapy exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Absolute neutrophil count ≥ 1.5 x 10^3/uL (within 28 days prior to randomization)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: evidence quote was not a verbatim substring of the trial text

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Platelets ≥ 100 x 10^3/uL (within 28 days prior to randomization)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: evidence quote was not a verbatim substring of the trial text

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have histologically or cytological confirmed diagnosis of clinical stage II-IIIB (excluding clinical N3 disease) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
